subject: hm-audio-command-migration
description: Migrating version 1 commands (docs/formats/hm-audio-plan.md, docs/adr/0006). input.plan is an hm-audio-plan document of version 1 and input.command an hm-audio-command of version 1. The plan migrates to version 2, the command to the version 2 commands the format record lists, and they're applied in order; expected is the resulting version 2 document, or the first rejection. The migrated commands themselves aren't compared. Generated cases come from version 1's property-test generators, with a fixed seed.
